scope: Fresh GitHub read-only audit after all three implementation merges, catalog maintenance and separate R2 verification merge. No Go/PG rerun, PR mutation, issue mutation, branch deletion or source modification.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-01: Bind refresh JWT issuance to the rotated authentication snapshot

task_checkboxes.text: Capture the locked user authentication snapshot during rotation; issue only from an unchanged snapshot.
Deterministic rotation-return barrier reproduces password change and freeze/reactivation races; reject changed identity/session and clear/revoke the descendant appropriately.
Run real PostgreSQL and handler regressions, including successful refresh and transient post-rotation read failure.
Review and merge implementation into #56 integration, then record exact source and test evidence.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-02: Include permission-management actions in company audit results

task_checkboxes.text: Add an explicit allowlist of the production permission management actions.
Exercise real create/update/assign/override/delete commands and verify company audit pagination exposes their records.
Preserve tenant/admin isolation, safe details projection and rejection of unknown permission actions.
Run PostgreSQL and HTTP regressions, review and merge with exact evidence.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-03: Preserve newer tenant-create dialogs and drafts during pending requests

task_checkboxes.text: Bind submission completion and busy state to the opening, session and submitted draft.
Keep a newer dialog or changed draft intact and prevent synchronous duplicate POSTs.
Distinguish confirmed creation from a subsequent list-refresh failure; avoid stale/unmounted feedback.
Run fixed real-component regressions, TypeScript and changed-code lint, then review and merge.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-04: Honor configured batch sizes in serial-claim ingest and outbound workers

task_checkboxes.text: Wire production ingest and outbound constructors to serial-claim semantics.
Verify configured batch progress for both adapters through their production worker construction.
Do not preclaim future tasks during slow processing; preserve batch bound, empty queue, cancellation and shutdown behavior.
Run fixed baseline/candidate tests and race regressions, review and merge.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-05: Fence employee activation against cross-home inviter revocation

task_checkboxes.text: Revalidate the current inviter under a lock held through activation commit; preserve lock ordering and bounded conflicts.
Use a real PostgreSQL barrier to commit cross-home inviter revocation while activation is paused.
Reject stale authority and roll back all user/mailbox/member/invitation side effects; retain legitimate cross-home activation.
Review and merge with exact PostgreSQL evidence.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-06: Fence tenant deletion across confirmation, session changes and unmount

task_checkboxes.text: Capture and revalidate session/component ownership before and after confirmation.
Guard duplicate row operations synchronously, including reentrant confirmation.
Suppress obsolete completions and preserve confirmed deletion versus refresh-failure semantics.
Run fixed real-component/request-layer regressions, TypeScript and lint, review and merge.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-08: Preserve activation storage failures instead of reporting duplicate identities

task_checkboxes.text: Map only relevant unique violations to duplicate-identity conflict.
Preserve operational error chains and existing concurrent-operation error semantics.
Inject real PostgreSQL user/mailbox write failures and test cancellation, real duplicates and complete transaction rollback.
Review and merge with exact source and regression evidence.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-09: Validate index-retry receipts and preserve confirmed recovery state

task_checkboxes.text: Validate the actual bounded integer receipt contract before claiming success.
Bind recovery feedback and updates to the active mount/session.
Retain a confirmed POST result on GET-refresh failure and provide read-only refresh recovery.
Run malformed-receipt, duplicate-action, unmount/session and refresh-error component tests, TypeScript/lint; review and merge.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-11: Reject nested SMTP MAIL commands without mutating the active envelope

task_checkboxes.text: Reject out-of-sequence nested MAIL with 503 before invoking sender admission or changing transaction state.
Publish backend sender state only after successful admission.
Exercise real loopback SMTP DATA and BDAT, accepted/refused second senders, RSET/EHLO/transaction completion and durable/non-durable paths.
Preserve existing tests and verify fixed baseline/candidate regressions and race suites; review and merge.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-12: Resolve internationalized SMTP recipient domains through IDNA DNS names

task_checkboxes.text: Convert recipient DNS domains to IDNA A-labels at the resolver boundary per RFC 6531.
Use the converted domain consistently for MX lookup, implicit MX fallback and appropriate TLS server naming while preserving recipient identity.
Cover Unicode DNS with a local deterministic DNS fixture, ASCII, address literals, null MX, temporary failures and cancellation.
Run fixed baseline/candidate and race regressions, review and merge with evidence.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-07: Bound SMTP DATA persistence by the configured operation timeout

task_checkboxes.text: Give DATA persistence an independent configured timeout while retaining shutdown cancellation.
Exercise real loopback SMTP with an adapter blocked until context cancellation; observe bounded temporary failure and released work.
Preserve durable-acceptance uncertainty and raw-object recovery; never acknowledge non-durable writes as success.
Run fixed baseline/candidate and race tests, review and merge.

issues.title: R5 NEXT1010-10: Validate SMTP envelope byte limits before outbound submission

task_checkboxes.text: Verify the octet limits against primary SMTP/SMTPUTF8 standards and enforce them in the shared production validation path.
Cover ASCII, UTF-8, quoted local parts and address literals at exact boundaries.
Invalid To/CC/BCC input must fail before quota, queue and raw-object side effects; valid limits remain supported.
Run fixed baseline/candidate and race regressions, review and merge.

retained_verification_base.purpose: Retained standalone preinstalled PostgreSQL verification configuration evidence

interpretation: The actual integration ref and merge objects take precedence over stale base.sha fields in closed PR payloads.
All five merged head branches are absent from the full inventory and individually return 404. This is consistent with automatic branch deletion being enabled; the deletion actor is not proven.
The four historical PR heads and PR20 base contain unique Git commits versus final integration. Unique commits alone do not establish unique patches or functional behavior.
PR17, PR24 and PR40 bases are ancestors of final integration, but all eight historical refs remain retained as requested.
PR17 remains draft and conflicting; PR56 remains draft/mergeable with an unstable summary. Neither was merged into main.
This audit observes API branch-protection fields and an empty visible ruleset list; the administrative classic-protection endpoint returned 403.
The temporary R2 verification merge targets its dedicated base. It contributes zero implementation TODOs.
This snapshot precedes any later documentation-only PR and does not assert later branch counts or heads.
